I can do that — before I send, please confirm a few details so I don't send the wrong thing:

1. Which recipients exactly? (Provide the project mailing-list address, or confirm that “the whole project list” means the list at [project-list@...] if that’s what you mean.)  
2. Which prepared note should I send? (The draft title or where it’s stored — or say “send the latest draft” or paste the content if needed.)  
3. Subject, CC/BCC, attachments, or signature to include or change?  
4. Confirm you want me to send it now (reply “Send now” to proceed).

Once you confirm these, I’ll send the email.
